subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What agent-visible payload shape should Feishu card-action callbacks use for `form_value`, `input_value`, `name`, `option`, and `options`?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the exact synthetic-message payload affects Feishu channel semantics and compatibility for existing button commands.

options.title: Structured Additive Payload
options.body: Expose the extra callback fields in a structured JSON payload only when those fields are present, while leaving simple button text and command callbacks unchanged.

options.title: Command-Argument Append
options.body: Append selected form and option values to the existing command-text path, reducing parser churn but losing a richer callback envelope.

options.title: Defer Callback Expansion
options.body: Keep only `action.value` support until maintainers choose a broader Feishu interaction contract.

recommendation.title: Structured Additive Payload
recommendation.body: Expose the extra callback fields in a structured JSON payload only when those fields are present, while leaving simple button text and command callbacks unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin contact, and this is a Feishu plugin payload-contract decision.
